title: Name a usable task-sync rebuild basis after later local edits
outcome: The inexact-own-export refusal and operator workflow identify a basis that matches current local planning and preserve the merged data commit when the saved own envelope is stale.
acceptance: The inexact-export remedy and task-planning documentation explain that the saved own project envelope must match current local planning and how to obtain a fresh basis while preserving the committed merged folder.
A regression covers saving the original export envelope, another local edit, a merged commit preserving the later edit, and the documented rebuild recovery.
